spans.s:
अ-शौच, अम्, n. impurity, foulness; legal impurity,
contamination, defilement contracted by the death of
a relation, or by the commission of prohibited acts,
&c.
—अशौच-त्व, अम्, n. impure or abandoned
nature or disposition; defilement, contamination.
आशौच आशौच, अम्, n. (fr. अ-शुचि), impurity.

अशौर्य अ-शौर्य, अम्, n. want of heroism,
cowardice.

असौकृ असौ-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्,
to do such and such a thing.

असौ-नामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. having such and such a
name.

असौम्य अ-सौम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, ugly, un-
lovely; disagreeable, displeasing.
—असौम्य-स्वर,
अस्, आ, अम्, having a bad or croaking voice.

असौष्ठव अ-सौष्ठव, अम्, n. ugliness, de-
formity; demerit, worthlessness.
